paragraphs.text: "Our quarrels behind us. Our foes before us. Death or triumph for us all!"
"I count the usurpers with my dagger, one death blow at a time."
The coils spiral like time itself, carrying spirits back around from death to reawakening.
Even war cannot dull Skemfar's beauty.
Lathril, queen of the ancient Einir, left a powerful legacy for her mortal descendants.
"We'll break their lines. The rest of you, follow!"
"The Cosmos Serpent favored us with his venom. As thanks, we sink fangs into those who dishonor the old ways."
"Better the dead depart utterly than be enslaved."
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand. —*The Theriad*
In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.
The barrier between existence and oblivion is thinner than you know.
Its wings disturb more than air.
Though the spirits' bodies were ethereal, Agnur soon learned that their blades were quite solid—and razor-sharp.
"One faith, but many hands in victory."
Kor have no concept of exploration. They return to homelands forgotten.
Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.
"When you hear thunder on a cloudless day, take cover and brace for the coming of the storm herd." —Skotov, Tin Street basket vendor
A blazing sun that never sets.
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi." —Expedition journal entry
Another imminent battle subsided in busy snuffling and carefree rooting.
Sometimes it's useful to take a break from existence.
"When you see a raven, head for the hills. It knows when the ghost-tide is headed in." —Sved, fisherman of Nephalia
"The secret entrance should be near."
To Jin-Gitaxias, perfection is not a goal, but a process.
"Rich" is a relative term.
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier." —Ob Nixilis
"As long as eyeblights exist, the hunt will never end." —Miara, Thorn of the Glade
"I've already seen so much evil, so much darkness. Why do you insist on adding more?" —Nissa Revane, to Dwynen
In beauty-obsessed Lys Alana, one cut of her blade means the difference between a high society feast and raking through the dungheap for scraps.
"Approach from downwind. Tread with care. Aim for the heart."
Like moonglove's flowers, the greatest beauty often masks the greatest dangers.
An elvish duel is a thing of beauty: the warriors' grace, the crash of steel, then the artful spray of blood.
"The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."
"This is our land. We will not allow eyeblights to poison its beauty."
"The elves tend the forest, and the forest sustains the elves. My role is to ensure that the cycle continues."
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest." —Nissa Revane
The faultless and immaculate castes form the lower tiers of elvish society, with the exquisite caste above them. At the pinnacle is the perfect, a consummate blend of aristocrat and predator.
"Smash this city to pieces." —Domri Rade
"Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."
A true reflection of nature: death fostering life.
In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.
"Llanowar remembers the Ice Age, the Phyrexian Invasion, and the Rift Era. So long as we draw breath, we will ensure such disasters never threaten our world again."
From the highest tiers of Dawn's Light Palace to the deepest shade of Wren's Run, the silver notes of the horn shimmer through the air, and all who hear it feel its pull.
Midwife to mothers and leader to all.
"Beauty determines value, and we determine beauty."
The Skelle spent days carving runes and erecting their scorn poles. The herd crushed them to splinters in seconds.
His blade carves a path for his people. His words guide them along it.
"What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."
Once a famed hunter and packmaster, now a renegade seeking his own path.
"New growth applies a healing poultice to wounds long scabbed over."
"If you ever want to leave this forest, now's the time."
His words echo every roar, screech, and howl of the wilds.
"Ancient ones, I call on you, your wisdom and your power, your will to claim again all that is rightfully yours."
"Your words are meaningless. The rustling of leaves is the only language that makes any sense."
Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.
"Run!" screamed its living mouths. "Come!" cried its dead ones.
"My rule persists beyond death itself."
All the aether charts in the world can't compete with the trained eye of a talented scout.
All the birds of the skies are the spirit's brood, gathered for safety under its wings.
"We gather the past from surface dwellers and sell it right back to them."
Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets. Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.
"The heroes of the past nourish our spirits by their example—and nourish our crops by their decay." —Jeddeg, philosopher of graves
"One more step and you're mine."
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process." —Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer
To the elves, her spear is a compass; to the boggarts, a harbinger of doom.
It watches over every absence.
Thunder doesn't always mean rain. Sometimes it means ruin.
Rumors swirl of a pair of deadly Golgari assassins known only as the Left and Right Hands of the Ochran.
It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.
The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.
Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.
It harmonizes with the essence of its master.
The essence of sunlight to brighten the way.
The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?" —Jhoira, master artificer
The essence of wind to lift up the weary.
Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared." —Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords
The Azorius symbol stares down like a great eye, reminding visitors of the watchful presence of Isperia and her lawmages.
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind." —Gadwick, the Wizened
Only when you've given up the search will the caves yield their secrets.
The stench of rotting meat lures flies, goblins, and young raptors.
Every part of the gate was reclaimed from forgotten ruins and imbued with new purpose by the Swarm.
The river split into many channels as it flowed to the Halimar Sea. Few travelers could follow the same one twice.
